data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: After sentinel exists, read-config.sh <legacy-key> exits non-zero with recovery command (implementation)
- DD2: read-config.sh dso.workflow continues normally after sentinel (implementation)

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh to add a sentinel lockout block.

Placement: AFTER the dso.workflow shim block (added by story 8607-5358-5d67-4987 / S1) and BEFORE the existing general .conf resolution section (the `_conf_lines` / `grep -m1` section near the end). If S1's shim block is not yet present (S1 not merged), place the lockout block immediately after the config file resolution section (after line 57).

Implementation:
```bash
# ── Sentinel lockout (post-migration hard error) ─────────────────────────────
# When .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated sentinel exists, legacy keys are locked
# out. dso.workflow and all other keys are unaffected.
# Fail-open: if git root is unavailable, skip lockout.
_LEGACY_LOCKOUT_KEYS="merge.strategy enforcement.strategy worktree.isolation_enabled attribution.enabled"
_sentinel_fired=0
if [[ -z "${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    _sentinel_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [[ -n "$_sentinel_root" ]] && test -f "$_sentinel_root/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated"; then
        for _lk in $_LEGACY_LOCKOUT_KEYS; do
            if [[ "$key" == "$_lk" ]]; then
                echo "Legacy key '${key}' is deprecated and locked out after migration. Run: git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf" >&2
                exit 1
            fi
        done
    fi
fi
```

Key constraints:
- The sentinel check ONLY fires when WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE is NOT set (i.e., only in normal production resolution path, not in test-isolated paths that use WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE)
- Must not fire when key is dso.workflow or any non-legacy key
- Recovery message must include the string "git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf"

## TDD Requirement
This task makes the RED tests from Task 1 turn GREEN. After adding the lockout block:
- `bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh` must pass (exit 0, FAILED: 0)
- Specifically: test_sentinel_lockout_exits_nonzero, test_sentinel_lockout_all_four_legacy_keys, test_sentinel_lockout_dso_workflow_unaffected, test_sentinel_absent_legacy_key_reads_normally, test_sentinel_fail_open_when_no_git_root

Remove RED markers from .test-index for the five sentinel test functions after the tests go GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] Lockout fires for merge.strategy when sentinel exists (exit 1)
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && touch "$_tmp/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" && out=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh" merge.strategy 2>&1); rc=$?; rm -rf "$_tmp"; [[ $rc -eq 1 ]]
- [ ] Lockout fires for enforcement.strategy when sentinel exists (exit 1)
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo 'enforcement.strategy=ci' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && touch "$_tmp/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" && out=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh" enforcement.strategy 2>&1); rc=$?; rm -rf "$_tmp"; [[ $rc -eq 1 ]]
- [ ] Recovery message emitted to stderr for locked-out key
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && touch "$_tmp/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" && stderr=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh" merge.strategy 2>&1 1>/dev/null); rm -rf "$_tmp"; echo "$stderr" | grep -q "git checkout HEAD"
- [ ] dso.workflow reads normally when sentinel exists (exit 0)
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo 'dso.workflow=local' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && touch "$_tmp/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" && cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow; rc=$?; rm -rf "$_tmp"; [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]
- [ ] Legacy keys read normally when sentinel absent (exit 0)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=$(mktemp) && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" && out=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh merge.strategy "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE"); rc=$?; rm -f "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE"; [[ $rc -eq 0 && "$out" == "direct" ]]
- [ ] Fail-open: lockout does NOT fire when WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE is set
  Verify: _f=$(mktemp) && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_f" && out=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$_f" bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh merge.strategy 2>&1); rc=$?; rm -f "$_f"; [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]
- [ ] RED markers removed from .test-index for sentinel test functions
  Verify: ! grep -q '\[test_sentinel' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement sentinel lockout block in read-config.sh
